title: Validate staged POC acceptance harness semantics
description:
Description:
Validate the staged acceptance harness itself before relying on it as POC proof.

Scenario:
- The harness can run while some stages are unimplemented and still distinguish pass, fail, blocked, deferred, and not-applicable states.

Procedure:
- Run the harness on a clean checkout before all POC features are complete.
- Inspect stage output and exit code behavior.

Required evidence:
- Each stage reports a result state and concrete reason.

Pass criteria:
- The harness exits nonzero only for in-scope failures, not for explicitly deferred unimplemented stages.

Failure classification:
- Ambiguous skipped stages or misleading zero exits are harness failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Harness validation proves staged result states and correct exit behavior for deferred versus failing POC stages.

title: Validate chapter ingestion workflow
description:
Description:
Validate chapter-by-chapter ingestion as the agent workflow for massive PDFs.

Scenario:
- An agent processes one Source Heading from the fixture without loading the whole PDF into context.

Procedure:
- Run ingest chapter for one fixture Source Heading.
- Inspect existing related Wiki Pages presented to the agent.
- Create or update one Wiki Page, add Citations, validate markers, and inspect logs.

Required evidence:
- Output shows selected Source Heading, bounded chunks, page update, Citation relation, valid marker check, and session log entries.

Pass criteria:
- Repeated runs update existing graph state rather than duplicating it.

Failure classification:
- Context-unbounded ingestion or duplicate repeated state is an ingestion workflow failure.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Chapter ingestion validation proves one-heading-at-a-time processing, cited Wiki Page synthesis, marker validation, logging, and idempotent repeated passes.

title: Validate Graph Retrieval ranking and cited evidence
description:
Description:
Validate the POC Graph Retrieval path with local Ollama embeddings.

Scenario:
- A query matching a seeded Wiki Page returns that page above raw Source Heading fallbacks and includes cited evidence.

Procedure:
- Ensure Ollama and the configured embedding model are available.
- Run a retrieval query against seeded fixture state.
- Inspect ranking scores and cited Source Heading evidence.

Required evidence:
- Output shows Wiki Page-first ranking, graph authority contribution, and citation evidence.

Pass criteria:
- Retrieval prefers authoritative Wiki Pages and can follow Citations to source context.

Failure classification:
- Missing Ollama/model reports concrete model and next action; poor ranking is a retrieval behavior failure.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval validation proves Wiki Page-first ranking, local embedding use when available, graph authority re-ranking, and cited Source Heading evidence.

title: Validate Wiki Page citation and manual link workflow
description:
Description:
Validate the core Wiki Page, Citation, Citation Marker, and Manual Link workflow.

Scenario:
- An agent creates or updates a Wiki Page with footnote-style Citation Markers, graph Citation relations, and an explicit Manual Link.

Procedure:
- Create or update one Wiki Page.
- Add at least one Citation relation to a Source Heading.
- Validate marker and relation agreement.
- Add and list one Manual Link with reason metadata.

Required evidence:
- Validation reports marker keys, Citation relation targets, unused or missing Citation failures, and Manual Link metadata.

Pass criteria:
- Page Body stays readable while canonical citation/link targets live in graph relations.

Failure classification:
- Raw source addresses in Page Body, missing graph Citations, or unvalidated markers are workflow failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Page/citation validation proves marker-relation agreement, explicit Manual Links, and readable Page Body behavior.

title: Validate session Change Log audit trail
description:
Description:
Validate the access and edit log as the POC mitigation for bad agent actions.

Scenario:
- An agent session performs a read and a write, then another agent can inspect enough information to undo or compensate.

Procedure:
- Start a session.
- Read a record through the CLI.
- Edit a record through the CLI.
- Show logs for the session.

Required evidence:
- Read log names command and target.
- Edit log includes target, before JSON where available, after JSON where available, command, session, and timestamp.

Pass criteria:
- Logs are sufficient for human review and agent-assisted compensation.

Failure classification:
- Missing before/after data or untraceable targets are audit failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Session validation proves CLI reads and writes append inspectable Change Log entries with concrete targets and before/after edit data.

title: Validate Source Heading and chunk persistence
description:
Description:
Validate persisted Source Headings and token-budgeted chapter chunk projections.

Scenario:
- A 200-page trusted PDF can be represented by headings and bounded chapter chunks without copying full PDF text into Wiki Pages.

Procedure:
- Run heading extraction and chunk projection for the fixture Source Document.
- Inspect heading paths, page ranges, order, token estimates, and chunk boundaries.

Required evidence:
- Output includes representative heading IDs, path hierarchy, page ranges, and chunk sizes.

Pass criteria:
- Headings are deterministic and chunks are within the configured token budget.

Failure classification:
- Missing heading hierarchy or unbounded chunks block chapter ingestion.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Heading/chunk validation proves deterministic Source Headings and bounded chapter chunks for the fixture PDF.

title: Validate Source Document PDF import idempotency
description:
Description:
Validate trusted PDF import into Surreal file buckets and graph metadata.

Scenario:
- IA-Mining-DG.pdf can be imported once and re-imported without duplicate graph state.

Procedure:
- Run source import for ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf twice.
- Inspect the Source Document record, file pointer, hash, MIME type, title, page count when available, and import status.

Required evidence:
- First run creates the record and file pointer.
- Second run reports idempotent existing state or a precise conflict.

Pass criteria:
- The PDF binary is stored in a Surreal file bucket and metadata remains stable across repeated runs.

Failure classification:
- Duplicate records, silent upload failure, or vague collision messages are import failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: PDF import validation proves file-bucket storage, Source Document metadata, and idempotent repeated import behavior for IA-Mining-DG.pdf.

title: Validate Graph Wiki schema smoke traversal
description:
Description:
Validate the schemafull SurrealDB model after it is applied.

Scenario:
- The database can store and traverse the core Graph Wiki records and relations.

Procedure:
- Apply the schema to an empty local database.
- Create one Source Document, Source Heading, Wiki Page, Citation, Agent Session, Change Log, Manual Link, and edited_in edge.
- Traverse citation and edit relations.

Required evidence:
- The smoke run reports created record IDs and successful relation traversal.

Pass criteria:
- Schema application is idempotent and the core graph shape works.

Failure classification:
- Broken constraints, missing indexes, or relation traversal failures block implementation beads that depend on schema.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: The schema smoke validation applies schema idempotently and proves core records, relations, indexes, and traversal behavior.

title: Validate local database doctor and lifecycle
description:
Description:
Validate the local SurrealDB management commands as an operator workflow.

Scenario:
- A developer or agent can diagnose and manage the local database without assuming ambient state.

Procedure:
- Run db doctor against the configured target.
- When a managed binary is configured, run start, status, and stop.

Required evidence:
- Output names URL or process identifier, namespace, database, file bucket capability, and actionable failures.

Pass criteria:
- The workflow either manages the process successfully or gives concrete reasons it cannot.

Failure classification:
- Vague local environment failures block POC execution.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: The database validation proves db doctor and, when configured, start/status/stop with explicit file-bucket capability reporting.

title: Validate SurrealDB query boundary failures
description:
Description:
Validate the minimal SurrealDB access boundary used by CLI commands and tests.

Scenario:
- A caller can distinguish configuration, connection, query, and credential-related failures without leaking secrets.

Procedure:
- Run focused tests or a scripted smoke path for config defaults, overrides, failed connection, and failed query.

Required evidence:
- Failures include operation, target URL or namespace/database, safe input identifier, reason, and next action.

Pass criteria:
- The boundary is type-safe enough for callers and observable enough for agents.

Failure classification:
- Leaked credentials or generic database errors are boundary failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: SurrealDB boundary validation covers config defaults/overrides and safe concrete connection/query failure reporting.

title: Validate deterministic ID idempotency and conflicts
description:
Description:
Validate that deterministic IDs support repeated imports and explicit collision handling.

Scenario:
- The same source identity, heading path, and page title inputs produce stable IDs across runs.

Procedure:
- Run the focused ID validation suite or script.
- Include repeated inputs, normalization variants, and deliberate collisions.

Required evidence:
- Output identifies generated IDs and conflict reports.

Pass criteria:
- Repeated inputs are idempotent and conflicts name operation, input, proposed ID, and existing record.

Failure classification:
- Non-determinism blocks idempotent ingestion.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: The ID validation proves stable repeated IDs and concrete collision failures for Source Documents, Source Headings, and Wiki Pages.

title: Validate CLI structured errors and bundled executable
description:
Description:
Validate the agent-facing CLI contract exposed by the bundled executable.

Scenario:
- An agent invokes the bundled Originium CLI for help, unknown commands, and missing arguments.

Procedure:
- Build the CLI bundle.
- Run usage, unknown-command, and missing-argument cases through the bundled executable.

Required evidence:
- Output includes operation, input, reason, and action fields for failures.
- The command path proves the bundled executable, not only source-level helpers.

Pass criteria:
- Failures are concrete enough for an agent to correct the command without hidden context.

Failure classification:
- Missing fields or vague messages are CLI contract failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: The bundled CLI validation covers success usage plus unknown-command and missing-argument failures with operation, input, reason, and action fields.

title: Create staged POC acceptance harness shell
description:
Description:
Create the acceptance harness structure before every underlying feature is complete, so future beads can plug in proof steps incrementally.

In scope:
- Add one documented command/script that runs staged checks for db, schema, source import, heading extraction, page/citation, retrieval, and change log.
- Each unavailable stage should fail or skip with explicit result state: pass, fail, blocked, deferred, or not-applicable.
- Use docs/architecture/quality/validation.md result-state language.
- Prefer bundled CLI commands as stage boundaries.

Out of scope:
- Making every stage pass immediately.
- Full fixture import or retrieval implementation.

Recommended skill: implement
acceptance_criteria: The harness can run on a clean checkout, reports staged result states, and exits nonzero only for in-scope failures rather than deferred unimplemented stages.

title: Validate PDF heading extraction on IA-Mining-DG fixture
description:
Description:
Validate the PDF extraction path on ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf before building durable ingestion behavior.

Scenario:
- Originium can derive chapter-level Source Headings and bounded text projections from a representative trusted PDF.

Procedure:
- Try the chosen TypeScript PDF reader path against the fixture.
- Determine whether outline/bookmarks, table-of-contents text, and page text are available.
- Estimate page count, heading count, and representative chapter text size.
- Identify token-estimation strategy and fallback when outline data is missing.

Required evidence:
- A repeatable script or documented command captures extraction route, counts, representative output, and failure shape.

Pass criteria:
- Heading extraction can proceed via outline, TOC parsing, or explicit fallback heuristics.

Failure classification:
- Missing file or extraction failure must report operation, input, reason, and action.

Out of scope:
- Persisting Source Heading records.
- Full OCR or scanned PDF support.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable script or documented command inspects ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf and records whether heading extraction can proceed via outline, TOC parsing, or fallback heuristics.

title: Implement Citation Marker parser and validation policy
description:
Description:
Implement the pure domain logic for Page Body Citation Markers before wiring graph Citation relations.

In scope:
- Define supported Citation Marker syntax for Page Body footnote-style markers.
- Parse marker keys and optional display labels from Page Body text.
- Compare parsed markers with graph Citation keys supplied by callers.
- Report missing marker, unused Citation, duplicate marker, and invalid marker syntax with concrete page/key context.

Out of scope:
- Persisting citations in SurrealDB.
- Structured page/block models.
- Raw source addresses in Page Body.

Recommended skill: implement
acceptance_criteria: Domain unit tests cover valid markers, duplicate markers, missing graph Citation, unused graph Citation, and invalid syntax without requiring SurrealDB.

title: Validate SurrealDB file bucket capability and CLI assumptions
description:
Description:
Validate how the currently running SurrealDB server exposes file buckets and what CLI operations must do to import PDF binaries safely.

Scenario:
- The local SurrealDB target supports the file bucket operations needed by Source Document import.

Procedure:
- Inspect supported SurrealDB file bucket commands and settings against the running server.
- Identify required namespace, database, auth, and allowlist configuration.
- Record the exact SurrealQL or API operations needed for upload, metadata, lookup, and idempotent re-import.

Required evidence:
- Notes on this bead include verified operations/settings and at least one concrete bad-configuration failure.

Pass criteria:
- Source import implementation can proceed with known file bucket operations and known failure shapes.

Failure classification:
- Missing support or bad configuration is a blocked product capability, not an implementation bug in source import.

Out of scope:
- Implementing source import.
- Building a UI for files.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Notes on the bead include verified file bucket operations/settings and at least one concrete failure shape that source import must surface.

title: Build minimal SurrealDB query execution boundary
description:
Description:
Implement the first package-owned SurrealDB access boundary used by CLI commands and tests.

In scope:
- Add a typed config reader and connection/query execution helper in packages/surreal.
- Keep direct SurrealDB client or CLI invocation details inside packages/surreal.
- Return typed/bounded failures with operation, target URL/namespace/database, query or file identifier where safe, and actionable reason.
- Add a small smoke helper suitable for schema and CLI work.

Out of scope:
- Full repository pattern for every table.
- Retrieval ranking or embeddings.
- PDF file bucket import behavior.

Recommended skill: implement
acceptance_criteria: A focused test covers config defaults/overrides and a failed connection/query path reports operation, target, reason, and next action without leaking credentials.

title: Introduce CLI command router and structured error contract
description:
Description:
Replace the placeholder CLI branching with a small explicit command router and shared structured error/output contract for agent-facing commands.

In scope:
- Define command result shape for success, usage errors, and operation failures.
- Route db/source/page/citation/session/log/ingest command groups without adding full feature behavior yet.
- Preserve bundled CLI build and direct executable use as the proof surface.
- Make unknown command and missing argument failures include command, input, reason, and next action.

Out of scope:
- Implementing full database, ingestion, page, citation, or retrieval behavior.
- Adding a large CLI framework unless it clearly removes complexity.

Recommended skill: implement
acceptance_criteria: bun test executes the bundled CLI and proves usage and unknown-command failures have concrete operation, input, reason, and action fields.

title: Validate end-to-end Graph Wiki POC against fixture PDF
description:
Description:
Validate the first end-to-end Graph Wiki POC using the IA-Mining-DG PDF fixture.

Scenario:
- Start or connect to correctly configured SurrealDB.
- Apply schema.
- Import the PDF into a file bucket.
- Create deterministic Source Document record.
- Extract Source Headings.
- Select one chapter and create an Ingestion Chunk projection.
- Create or update one Wiki Page from the chapter.
- Add at least one Citation relation and matching Citation Marker.
- Validate Citation Markers against graph Citations.
- Query the Wiki Page through Graph Retrieval.
- Show Change Log entries for the session.

Procedure:
- Run the documented POC acceptance command or script against ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf.

Required evidence:
- Command output names each stage, target record IDs, and result state.
- Failures include operation, input identifier, reason, and next action.

Pass criteria:
- The smallest useful loop completes and produces retrievable cited wiki state plus session log evidence.

Failure classification:
- Missing SurrealDB file support, PDF extraction support, Ollama model, or Citation mismatch must fail explicitly.

Out of scope:
- Full document ingestion.
- OCR or approval gates.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: A single documented validation command proves the smallest useful loop against ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf and fails with concrete operation identifiers.

title: Implement Graph Retrieval with Ollama embeddings
description:
Description:
Implement the POC Graph Retrieval path that makes synthesized Wiki Pages the useful knowledge layer instead of building around raw PDF text search.

In scope:
- Provider interface for embeddings with Ollama as the first implementation.
- Default local embedding model nomic-embed-text unless configured otherwise.
- Embed Wiki Pages first.
- Hybrid candidate retrieval over Wiki Page title/body and Source Heading title/path/source metadata.
- Ranking signals for full-text score, vector similarity when available, inbound cites authority, and Manual Link authority.
- Preferred answer/search flow: Wiki Pages first, follow Citations to Source Headings, extract source text from PDF only when verification/additional context is needed, fall back to Source Heading search when wiki synthesis is missing.

Out of scope:
- Embedding full PDF body text durably in the database.
- Remote embedding providers beyond the provider interface.

Proof / validation:
- With Ollama and nomic-embed-text available, a query matching the seeded Wiki Page returns that page above raw Source Heading fallbacks and includes cited Source Heading evidence.
- Missing Ollama/model produces a concrete operation/model/actionable error.
acceptance_criteria: originium page search and retrieval internals prefer Wiki Pages, use local embeddings when available, and re-rank with graph authority.

title: Implement Chapter Ingestion workflow command
description:
Description:
Implement the chapter-by-chapter ingestion workflow that agents use to absorb large PDFs without loading the whole Source Document into context.

In scope:
- originium ingest chapter --source <source-id> --heading <heading-id>.
- Select Source Heading, create token-budgeted Ingestion Chunks, and expose existing related Wiki Pages for agent synthesis.
- Support creating/updating Wiki Pages, adding Citations, optionally adding Manual Links, and validating Citation Markers.
- Log all reads and edits through the session Change Log.
- Repeated passes over the same Source Document should update existing graph state rather than duplicating it.

Out of scope:
- Autonomous whole-document ingestion.
- Automatic Manual Links.
- Approval gates.

Proof / validation:
- Running the command for one fixture chapter produces or guides creation of at least one Wiki Page, one matching Citation relation, valid Citation Markers, and visible Change Log entries for the session.
acceptance_criteria: originium ingest chapter orchestrates one Source Heading at a time and supports repeated passes over the same Source Document.

title: Implement Wiki Page, Citation, and Manual Link CLI
description:
Description:
Implement the core agent-facing CLI for durable Wiki Pages and graph relations.

In scope:
- originium page create/read/update/search.
- originium citation add/list/validate.
- Citation Marker parsing for footnote-style markers in Page Body.
- cites relations from Wiki Pages to Source Headings with key, label, quote, and created_at metadata.
- Validate marker/relation agreement and report unused or missing citations.
- originium link add/list for explicit Manual Links only, with reason/session/label metadata where available.

Out of scope:
- Automatic semantic link creation.
- Structured page/block model.
- Raw source addresses in Page Body.

Proof / validation:
- A smoke test creates a Wiki Page with a Citation Marker, adds the matching Citation relation, validates successfully, then demonstrates concrete failure output for a missing marker or unused Citation key.
acceptance_criteria: Agents can create/read/update/search Wiki Pages, manage graph Citations, validate Citation Markers, and add explicit Manual Links.

title: Extract Source Headings and token-budgeted chapter chunks
description:
Description:
Implement PDF Source Heading extraction and Ingestion Chunk projection for Chapter Ingestion.

In scope:
- Layered heading extraction: PDF outline/bookmarks, table-of-contents parsing, then heading-like text fallback.
- Persist Source Heading records with title, heading_path, level, page range, order, destination, and extraction method.
- originium source headings <source-id>.
- originium source chunk <source-id> --heading <heading-id> --max-tokens <n>.
- Prefer Source Heading boundaries and split only when a heading exceeds the token budget.
- Treat chunk text as an agent-readable projection read from the stored Source Document file.

Out of scope:
- Durable storage of full extracted source text.
- OCR for scanned PDFs.
- Whole-document loading into agent context.

Proof / validation:
- Running heading extraction on ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf creates ordered Source Headings and can project one selected chapter chunk with source document ID, heading ID, page range, token estimate, and extraction method.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture PDF yields ordered Source Headings with extraction method metadata and chapter chunk projections under a configurable token budget.

title: Record Agent Sessions, Change Logs, and edited_in relations
description:
Description:
Implement the POC access and edit logging model so agent work can be inspected and undone through compensating edits.

In scope:
- originium session start and session show <session-id>.
- originium log show --session <session-id>.
- Logging wrapper for CLI reads and writes.
- Read logs include session, command, target records or query string, and timestamp.
- Edit logs include session, command, target records, before JSON when available, after JSON when available, and timestamp.
- edited_in relations from changed records to Agent Session where useful for traversal.

Out of scope:
- Automated rollback.
- Human approval gates or fine-grained permissions.

Proof / validation:
- A CLI smoke flow starts a session, reads a record, edits a record, then `originium log show --session <id>` shows both entries with concrete targets and before/after data for the edit.
acceptance_criteria: Every Graph Wiki CLI read/write appends a Change Log entry and session logs can be inspected by ID.

title: Import Source Documents into Surreal file buckets
description:
Description:
Implement Source Document import for trusted PDFs using Surreal file buckets for binary storage and graph records for metadata.

In scope:
- originium source import-pdf <path>.
- SHA-256 hashing, MIME type, title, source URI/path, page count when available, import timestamp, and extraction status.
- File bucket storage instead of JSON field storage.
- Repeated import behavior using deterministic Source Document IDs.
- Concrete errors for missing file, unsupported MIME, missing file-bucket support, upload failure, and ID collision.

Out of scope:
- Persisting extracted full body text into wiki records.
- OCR.
- Heading extraction beyond metadata needed to record page count/title.

Proof / validation:
- `originium source import-pdf ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf` creates one Source Document record and file pointer, then a second run reports idempotent existing state or a precise conflict.
acceptance_criteria: originium source import-pdf stores the PDF binary in a Surreal file bucket and creates an idempotent Source Document record.

title: Implement deterministic Graph Wiki record IDs
description:
Description:
Implement deterministic ID helpers so repeated imports and ingestion passes are idempotent where practical.

In scope:
- Source Document IDs from normalized title or filename plus short SHA-256 hash.
- Source Heading IDs from Source Document identity, normalized heading path, page range, and order.
- Wiki Page slugs from titles with explicit conflict handling.
- Concrete error messages naming operation, input identifier, proposed ID, and existing conflicting record.

Out of scope:
- Generated Agent Session and Change Log IDs.
- Automated merge or deduplication policy beyond explicit conflict reporting.

Proof / validation:
- Unit tests cover stable ID generation, normalization, repeated input idempotency, and collision error formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Domain helpers produce stable IDs for repeated imports and clear conflict errors for collisions.

title: Implement local SurrealDB management commands
description:
Description:
Implement the CLI commands that make local development database state explicit instead of assuming a correctly configured ambient SurrealDB server.

In scope:
- originium db start, stop, status, and doctor.
- Resolve SurrealDB binary from ORIGINIUM_SURREAL_BIN or PATH.
- Use a project-owned data directory and explicit namespace, database, and auth configuration.
- Validate required file-bucket allowlist/settings and report concrete failures.
- Support an external SurrealDB URL for users who do not want the CLI-managed process.

Out of scope:
- Auto-downloading or vendoring SurrealDB binaries.
- Applying application schema; that belongs to the schema issue.

Proof / validation:
- `originium db doctor` reports operation, URL or process identifier, namespace/database, file-bucket capability, and actionable reason for any failure.
- `originium db start && originium db status && originium db stop` works on a clean checkout with a configured binary.
acceptance_criteria: originium db start/stop/status/doctor can manage or diagnose a local SurrealDB process with file bucket support and explicit auth.

title: Define and apply schemafull Graph Wiki SurrealDB schema
description:
Description:
Define the schemafull SurrealDB model that makes the graph database the canonical Graph Wiki store.

In scope:
- .surql definitions for source_document, source_heading, wiki_page, agent_session, change_log, cites, manual_link, and edited_in.
- Fields from SPEC.md, including flexible metadata only where extractor/provider-specific.
- Relation metadata and constraints, including Citation key uniqueness within a Wiki Page where practical.
- originium db apply-schema command.
- A type-safe access layer plan or implementation where practical, with raw SurrealQL retained for unsupported query shapes.

Out of scope:
- Source binary import, PDF extraction, and retrieval ranking implementation.
- Committing to Surqlize if it cannot handle required SurrealDB features cleanly.

Proof / validation:
- `originium db apply-schema` is idempotent against an empty local database.
- A schema smoke test can create and relate one Source Document, Source Heading, Wiki Page, Citation, Agent Session, Change Log, Manual Link, and edited_in edge.
acceptance_criteria: Checked-in schema can be applied repeatedly and creates the core tables, graph relations, indexes, and constraints needed by the POC.

title: POC Graph Wiki ingestion and retrieval
description:
Description:
Build the first useful Graph Wiki loop for a trusted PDF source. The canonical state lives in SurrealDB graph records and relations; markdown-like output is only a projection.

In scope:
- Local SurrealDB process management and schema application.
- Source Document import into Surreal file buckets.
- Source Heading extraction and chunk projection.
- Wiki Page, Citation, Manual Link, Agent Session, and Change Log CLI flows.
- Graph Retrieval using Wiki Pages first, then cited Source Headings.
- Viewer UI for inspection.
- End-to-end proof against ~/Downloads/IA-Mining-DG.pdf.
- Focused validation beads for each major product, operator, integration, and UI behavior.

Out of scope:
- OCR, contradiction modeling, approval gates, automatic rollback, automatic semantic links, and reusable plugin packaging.

Proof / validation:
- Implementation children define focused build proof.
- Validation children define scenario proof for CLI behavior, database lifecycle, schema traversal, source import, heading/chunk extraction, citations/links, audit logs, retrieval, chapter ingestion, harness behavior, end-to-end fixture ingestion, and UI inspection.
- The epic is done when the focused validations pass, the end-to-end validation passes, and the inspection UI validation can view the produced graph state.
acceptance_criteria: POC can import the fixture PDF, synthesize at least one cited Wiki Page, retrieve it through Graph Retrieval, show the session Change Log, and pass the focused validation beads for each major behavior.

title: Validate Graph Wiki agent skill workflow
description:
Description:
Validate the product-specific Graph Wiki agent skill against the implemented CLI.

Scenario:
- A fresh agent follows the skill to read source context, update a Wiki Page, add Citations, validate markers, and inspect Change Logs.

Procedure:
- Run a small fixture workflow using only the skill and CLI help/commands.
- Record any missing instructions or misleading terminology.

Required evidence:
- The agent can complete the workflow without private planning context.

Pass criteria:
- The skill preserves the Graph Wiki model: Page Body remains readable, citations are graph relations, and Change Logs are used for review.

Failure classification:
- Needing tribal knowledge or putting canonical source addresses in Page Body is a skill failure.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: Agent skill validation proves a fresh agent can complete a cited Wiki Page update and Change Log inspection using only repo-local guidance and the CLI.

title: Validate inspection UI against fixture graph state
description:
Description:
Validate the read-only inspection UI over produced Graph Wiki state.

Scenario:
- A human can inspect Source Documents, Source Headings, Wiki Pages, Citations, graph neighborhoods, Agent Sessions, and Change Logs after fixture ingestion.

Procedure:
- Start the web app against seeded or fixture-created state.
- Use browser or Playwright checks for the main inspection routes.
- Capture screenshots or structured assertions for layout and data presence.

Required evidence:
- UI renders each planned inspection surface without overlapping, hidden, or misleading state.

Pass criteria:
- The UI is read-only, consistent with CLI mutation semantics, and useful for human-in-the-loop review.

Failure classification:
- Missing data surfaces, broken layout, or UI-owned mutation behavior are UI validation failures.

Recommended skill: validate-behavior
acceptance_criteria: UI validation proves the read-only inspection routes render fixture graph state for documents, headings, pages, citations, neighborhoods, sessions, and logs.

title: Replace web placeholder with TanStack Start inspection shell
description:
Description:
Replace the placeholder web app boundary with the smallest real TanStack Start inspection shell that can later render Graph Wiki projections.

In scope:
- Add TanStack Start app structure and dev/build scripts.
- Create navigation placeholders for Source Documents, Wiki Pages, graph, and sessions/logs.
- Keep UI read-only during the POC.
- Avoid duplicating mutation semantics from the CLI.

Out of scope:
- Real database reads before the Surreal access layer is ready.
- Editing UI.
- Decorative landing page.

Recommended skill: implement
acceptance_criteria: The web app build gate or repo build gate passes, and the app has stable read-only routes/placeholders for the planned inspection surfaces.

title: Write repo-local Graph Wiki agent skill
description:
Description:
Write product-specific agent guidance for using Originium once the POC CLI surface is stable enough to exercise.

In scope:
- Instructions for starting a session, importing or selecting Source Documents, reading Source Headings/chunks, updating Wiki Pages, adding Citations, validating Citation Markers, adding Manual Links only on explicit request, and inspecting Change Logs.
- Warnings against putting raw source addresses, metadata, or canonical Citation targets into Page Body.
- Error-handling expectations aligned with the project principle of concrete technical errors.

Out of scope:
- Generic coding-agent contributor instructions.
- Reusable plugin packaging.

Proof / validation:
- An agent can follow the skill against CLI help or a small fixture flow and complete a cited Wiki Page update without additional instructions.
acceptance_criteria: A .agents/skills/graph-wiki skill teaches agents how to use the CLI while preserving the Graph Wiki model.

title: Build inspection UI for Graph Wiki state
description:
Description:
Build the first UI as a viewer and inspection surface for Graph Wiki state. Editing remains CLI-first during the POC.

In scope:
- Source Document list.
- Source Heading outline for a Source Document.
- Wiki Page reader.
- Citation panel for a Wiki Page.
- Graph neighborhood view for a record.
- Agent Session and Change Log viewer.
- Use the same package seams as the CLI for reads; do not duplicate mutation semantics in the UI.

Out of scope:
- Ingestion orchestration in the UI.
- Full wiki editing UI.
- UI-owned database mutation semantics.

Proof / validation:
- After the fixture smoke flow creates graph state, the UI can render the Source Document, headings, page, citations, neighborhood, session, and logs without overlapping or misleading state.
acceptance_criteria: The web app can inspect Source Documents, Source Headings, Wiki Pages, Citations, graph neighborhoods, Agent Sessions, and Change Logs.

title: Product-specific Graph Wiki agent skill and docs
description:
Description:
Create product-specific agent instructions for working with Originium as a Graph Wiki. This is about guiding agents that use the product, not generic project contributor docs.

In scope:
- Repo-local .agents/skills/graph-wiki guidance once the CLI shape is real enough to document.
- Instructions for preserving Citation Markers, creating Citation relations, avoiding raw source addresses in Page Bodies, and using Change Logs for review.
- Small validation exercise using the implemented CLI help or commands.

Out of scope:
- Publishing a reusable external plugin.
- Changing SPEC.md or CONTEXT.md unless a separate decision requests it.

Proof / validation:
- The skill can guide an agent through reading a chunk, updating a Wiki Page, adding Citations, and validating markers without needing additional tribal knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Repo-local agent guidance exists for safe Graph Wiki operation and is exercised against the implemented CLI.

title: Scaffold TypeScript monorepo
description: Create the early Originium Bun workspace, package layout, basic validation scripts, Surreal schema placeholder, docs map, and Graph Wiki agent skill.
close_reason: Implemented early TypeScript monorepo scaffold and validation passed.

title: Assess reusable agent OS extraction after POC evidence
description:
Description:
Use POC evidence to decide whether the Originium agent factory should be extracted into reusable agent OS assets and what those assets would own.

In scope:
- Review implemented CLI, skills, schema, logging, ingestion workflow, validation evidence, and orchestrator experience.
- Separate reusable workflow patterns from Originium-specific product assumptions.
- Compare distribution options: repo-local copy, script-managed sync, symlink, Codex plugin, or future Codex feature.

Out of scope:
- Building packaging before the POC is proven.
- Changing POC architecture to satisfy hypothetical reuse.

Recommended skill: architecture-audit
acceptance_criteria: A follow-up decision or backlog captures whether reusable agent OS extraction is useful, with concrete boundaries and distribution tradeoffs.

title: Validate later reusable agent OS extraction
description:
Description:
Track deferred investigation into whether the repo-local agent factory should be extracted into a reusable agent operating system after Originium proves the workflow.

In scope:
- Identify what remains generic across projects versus what is Originium-specific binding.
- Validate whether Codex plugin packaging, direct skill copying, symlinks, or another distribution path is least bad after real usage.
- Capture risks around session-scoped enablement, skill discoverability, local tool dependencies, and update workflow.

Out of scope:
- Blocking POC ingestion or retrieval work.
- Reintroducing a plugin before repo-local skills prove useful.

Recommended skill: manage-beads
acceptance_criteria: After the POC acceptance test passes, produce a decision or implementation backlog for reusable agent OS extraction, or explicitly close as not worth doing.
